Cargo.toml.comment: repoWide: crates whose code walks the repository, so every file is an input. extra: files outside the crate and its path dependencies that its code reads. tools: commands whose output (a version) is an input, for tests that run them. noCache: crates whose tests depend on what the machine has (containers, psql, network), so a result must never be reused. scanIgnore: files whose ".." literals are not reads. tools/nx-cargo/check.cjs fails on a read this file does not cover.

noCache.loams-compat: runs psql when the machine has it
noCache.loams-sqldb: local tests talk to services over curl
noCache.loams-sqlgate: real-gate tests drive podman and curl
noCache.loams-upgrade: the bundle code downloads releases with curl
